scope: Construction of the manual debugger and representative diagnostic dry run. Live repairs require a separately scoped current invocation.

checks.expected: Manual debugger scopes the current symptom, project/chat identity, expected versus actual behavior and repair authority before execution.
checks.method: Compare the current user request and manual-mode answer against AGENT, playbook, config, invocation and case responses.

checks.expected: Diagnosis distinguishes reproduced causes from hypotheses; a repair requires the original failure to pass and a relevant regression to remain correct.
checks.method: Execute installed maintenance-classifier examples and source-matched isolated checkpoint tests; inspect the investigation report and repair gates.

checks.expected: A legitimate low-usage stop persists after healthy readings until explicit reviewed resume, and normal recovery is distinguished from a reserve grant.
checks.method: Run the existing healthy-reading/persistent-stop regression and reproduce prepare-review without a grant in an isolated fixture; inspect live state without mutations.

checks.expected: Foreign or unknown task identity, uncertain jobs and stale evidence do not supply resume or repair authority.
checks.method: Review fixed adversarial cases against task-checkpoint scope, ownership and telemetry source contracts.

checks.expected: Building the agent changes no live hook, checkpoint, ownership or account configuration; no background job, cross-chat message or paid execution is launched.
checks.method: Compare protected live-state hashes before and after validation, inspect tool receipts and zero-worker configuration.

checks.expected: Every durable package asset is indexed and every applicable review check records id, expected, method, status, evidence and observed.
checks.method: Run Agent Forge readiness audit and independently inspect inventory, criterion snapshots and review fields.

checks.expected: A first-case report provides verified observations, a useful next action and clear limits; prior-chat claims do not become current runtime proof.
checks.method: Compare report claims with current maintenance/status, on-disk hook/config readback, source and deterministic reproduction.

checks.expected: Evidence-supported corrections are saved in the operating playbook and affected checks are rerun without altering frozen acceptance.
checks.method: Verify saved lesson text/hash and compare acceptance SHA256 before and after isolated checks.
